# MLflow Trace Archival Benchmark

> An independent PostgreSQL benchmark for MLflow trace archival. It measures the cost of selecting eligible traces and the cost of ingesting new spans while selection runs, and checks trace IDs and ordering on synthetic workloads.

The SQL study measures database planning and execution on a reduced schema. The finder and ingestion studies use the pinned MLflow 3.18.0 SQLAlchemy store on migrated tables. Use each study’s timing definition and workload description when comparing results.

## Start here

- [Project overview and quick start](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kenchengkc/mlflow-trace-archive-bench/main/README.md): Read a published report with Python or run a small local SQL benchmark.
- [Contribution guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kenchengkc/mlflow-trace-archive-bench/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Set up PostgreSQL, run tests, and report a reproducible comparison.

## Benchmark studies

- [SQL query strategies](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kenchengkc/mlflow-trace-archive-bench/main/results/strategy-study/README.md): Compare global ordering, per-experiment selection, and a bounded probe across archive layouts.
- [MLflow’s candidate finder](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kenchengkc/mlflow-trace-archive-bench/main/results/finder/README.md): Compare driver and SQL timings, deferred fallback, and merging at 1,001 experiments.
- [Concurrent trace ingestion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kenchengkc/mlflow-trace-archive-bench/main/results/ingestion/README.md): Compare selection latency and write throughput, serialization, PostgreSQL execution, write-ahead logging, and out-of-line span storage.

## Optional

- [Full 45-case SQL timing table](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kenchengkc/mlflow-trace-archive-bench/main/results/strategy-study/matrix.md): Compare published timings by experiment scope, batch size, and archive depth.
- [Machine-readable results](https://github.com/kenchengkc/mlflow-trace-archive-bench/tree/main/results): Compressed JSON measurements, query plans, and ordering checks.
